title: Master of Dungeon: AI TEXT RPG - An alternative for people who'd like to play D&D solo
author: Tigeline
selftext:
Hey,

My brother and I are working on a game that's kind of a mix between D&D and a text-based RPG. The demo just launched - you can already test the core gameplay, loot system, and basic hero progression.  
If you'd like to check it out or share feedback, feel free to join our Discord: [https://discord.gg/QB54WXdYgN](https://discord.gg/QB54WXdYgN)

We'll be unlocking new features every few days, and player suggestions will help shape what comes next

comments.author: SoberSeahorse
comments.body: This is pretty cool. Is this for iOS?

replies.author: Tigeline
replies.body: Hey, I’m glad you like it! Yes, it’s available on iOS too :)

replies.author: SoberSeahorse
replies.body: Cool. I’ll check it out. Thank you for sharing.

replies.author: SoberSeahorse
replies.body: I can’t seem to find it. Could you share a link to the App Store page?

replies.author: Tigeline
replies.body: sure, here's a link to testflight: [https://testflight.apple.com/join/mg6UrBH9](https://testflight.apple.com/join/mg6UrBH9)

comments.author: Never_Zero
comments.body: What features are there? Is the whole quest generated or preset? Do you type in what you want to do or is it all choose one of 4 options like in the screen shot? Is there any filtering for example no dismemberment or extreme choices such as using a captured enemy as bait for monsters? Homebrew classes or monsters possible?

replies.author: Tigeline
replies.body:
I'm answering all the questions now:

1. The entire adventure is generated, but there are certain guidelines it follows to keep the story on the right track. However, players have full freedom to choose where they want to go.
2. Currently, there are 4 options (also generated depending on the situation). In the future, we’ll also introduce the ability to type your own choices, so everyone can pick whichever option they prefer.
3. As for extreme situations - they do happen depending on the context :D
4. At the moment, you can’t create your own classes or monsters yet, but we definitely plan to add that in the future :)

comments.author: JezebelRoseErotica
comments.body: Brilliant. I’ll drop feedback as an avid dnd player! Off the bat: increase text display speed. Consider Elevenlabs audio API for voice narration ❤️‍🔥 shoot, that’s worth a subscription fee.

replies.author: Tigeline
replies.body: Thanks a lot for your feedback! We're already working to improve it

comments.author: FragrantContest7811
comments.body: Does this use gpt? Or is it just pre determined stories?

replies.author: Tigeline
replies.body: We just create a rough outline to stay on track, and the AI builds the story around it :)

replies.author: FragrantContest7811
replies.body: Interesting, how do I try it?

replies.author: Tigeline
replies.body:
If you're playing on iOS, here's the link:
https://testflight.apple.com/join/mg6UrBH9

If you're playing on Android, the best way is to join our Discord and fill out the survey, or send me your email in a private message so I can add you to the beta testers :)
